_說明: THP11 文法與聽力題。grammar＝課本 Grammar 頁（choice 選擇、order 排句子）；listening＝Everyday English 句型的聽力題（reply 聽句子選回應、lfill 聽句子填空、lpick 選出聽到的句子、lorder 聽句子排句子）。a＝正確選項位置（從 0 開始），App 會打亂選項順序。

U1.title: Present Tense & Present Continuous
U1.zh: 現在式：現在的事實、常常發生、永遠為真的事；現在進行式：正在發生的事
rules: 現在式 Be 動詞：am / is / are
Jess is usually late.
現在式一般動詞：主詞是 he / she / it 要加 s
Jess studies English every Monday.
現在進行式：am / is / are + V-ing
The giraffes are drinking water.
phrases: always, usually, sometimes, never, every day, once a week
mistakes: 主詞是 Jess（she），動詞加 s
進行式不能少 am / is / are
一般動詞前面不加 be 動詞

U2.title: Relative Clauses
U2.zh: 關係代名詞：放在名詞後面，補充說明是「哪一個」
rules: who / that → 人
The boy who is wearing a striped shirt is my friend.
which / that → 動物、東西、想法
This is a smartphone app that can help you plan your trip.
whose → 某人的（所有格）
I can't find the girl whose smartwatch is on the table.
where → 地點
That's the park where weird people were hanging out.
when → 時間
I can't remember a time when there weren't any smartphones.
mistakes: The boy which is wearing a hat
The boy who is wearing a hat
the girl who bag is red
the girl whose bag is red
地點用 where，時間才用 when

U3.title: Past Tense & Past Perfect Tense
U3.zh: 過去式：已經結束的事；過去完成式：兩件過去的事，比較早發生的那件
rules: 過去式 Be 動詞：was / were
The students were tired.
過去式一般動詞
They fell asleep on the bus.
過去完成式：had + 過去分詞（先發生）＋ 過去式（後發生）
Everyone had already eaten dinner when Dad got home.
phrases: had + p.p.（更早）→ 過去式（後來）→ 現在
when, before, after, already, by the time
mistakes: When Dad got home, everyone already ate.
When Dad got home, everyone had already eaten.
比較早發生的事用 had + p.p.

U1.title: Talking About Trends
U1.zh: 描述流行：用形容詞或名詞說東西看起來怎麼樣
rules: (n.) is/are + 形容詞
Roller skates are old-fashioned.
(n.) look/seem + 形容詞
Roller skating seems fun.
(n.) look/seem like + 名詞
Roller skates look like rollerblades.

U2.title: Asking People to Help
U2.zh: 請求幫忙：禮貌地請別人做事，以及怎麼回答
rules: Please + 原形動詞…
Please give me that pencil.
Can / Could / Would you + 原形動詞…?
Could you help me with my homework, please?
please 可以放句首、句尾或 you 後面
Would you please give me a cookie?
phrases: Okay. ／ Sure! ／ No problem! ／ Just a second. ／ Here you go. ／ One moment, please.
Sorry + 原因或建議：Sorry, I don't have any extra money. Maybe you can ask Jeff.

U3.title: Talking About Directions
U3.zh: 問路：問附近有沒有某個地方、怎麼走
rules: Is there a (n.) nearby?
Yes, there's a drugstore next to the bank.
Could you tell me how to get to (n.)?
Sure, go straight down 2nd Street.
phrases: next to 在旁邊 ／ across from 在對面 ／ between A and B 在 A 和 B 之間 ／ on the corner of A and B 在 A 和 B 的轉角
go straight down 沿著…直走 ／ go past 經過 ／ turn right/left at 在…右轉／左轉
mistakes: between the bank or the hotel
between the bank and the hotel
how to get to the park

U1.tip: every Monday → 現在式；Jess 是第三人稱，動詞加 s
Look! → 正在發生，用進行式
永遠為真的事實用現在式

U1.q: Ted ___ on the sneakers right now.
My brother ___ his sneakers every weekend.
U1.tip: every weekend → 現在式，第三人稱加 s
頻率字 never 搭配現在式

U2.q: The boy ___ is wearing a striped shirt is my friend.
This is an app ___ can help you plan your trip.
I can't find the girl ___ smartwatch is on the table.
That's the park ___ we played soccer.
I remember the day ___ I got my first phone.
The boy ___ headphones are white is doing homework.
I have a dog ___ loves to swim.
She is the teacher ___ helped me with my homework.
Summer is the season ___ we go to the beach.

opts: The phone which I bought is new.
The phone who I bought is new.
The phone where I bought is new.
The girl whose bag is red is Amy.
The girl who bag is red is Amy.
The girl which bag is red is Amy.

U3.q: Mom ___ a doctor.
U3.tip: 單數主詞的過去式用 was

U3.q: The students ___ tired after the trip.
Yesterday they ___ asleep on the bus.
Everyone ___ dinner when Dad got home.
U3.tip: 先發生的事用 had + p.p.

U3.q: After I ___ lunch, I closed the menu.
Ted ___ to the beach last weekend.
When we arrived, the movie ___.
U3.tip: 電影比我們到達更早開始 → had started

U3.q: She ___ sick people when she was a nurse.
He had read lots of reviews before he ___ the hotel.
選出正確的句子
opts: I had finished my homework before I watched TV.
I finished my homework before I had watch TV.
I have finished my homework before I watched TV.
U3.tip: 先寫完功課 had finished，再看電視 watched

U3.q: 選出正確的句子
opts: They were at the beach yesterday.
They was at the beach yesterday.
They are at the beach yesterday.

U3.tip: 先發生 had eaten，後發生 got
had ordered 比 closed 更早

U1.tip: look 後面接形容詞，不加 like

U1.say: Her dress looks like a princess dress.
Fidget spinners were a fad. They seem boring now.
U1.q: Fidget spinners were a fad. They ___ boring now.

U1.tip: look like + 名詞；複數主詞用 look

U1.say: That song seems like a classic.
opts: That song seems like a classic.
That song seem like a classic.

U2.say: Could you help me with my homework?
U2.q: Could you ___ me with my homework?

U2.say: Would you please close the window?
opts: Would you please close the window?
U2.tip: Would you please… 是很有禮貌的請求

U2.say: Could you lend me a hand?
opts: Could you lend me a hand?
Could you lending me a hand?
Could you to lend me a hand?

U2.tip: please 放句首、句尾，或 Would you 後面

U2.q: Could you pass me the salt, please?
U2.tip: 答應並遞東西：Here you go.

U2.q: Marco, could you lend me some money?
opts: Sorry, I don't have any extra money.

U2.q: Can you help me carry this box?
opts: Sorry, I'm busy. Maybe you can ask Tom.
U2.tip: 拒絕：Sorry + 原因 + 建議

U2.q: Could you give me the remote, please?
Would you open the door for me?

U2.tip: Would you please + 原形動詞

U3.q: Is there a drugstore ___?

U3.say: The bank is between the bookstore and the pizza restaurant.
U3.q: The bank is ___ the bookstore and the pizza restaurant.

U3.say: The park is across from the shopping mall.
U3.q: The park is across ___ the shopping mall.

U3.say: The café is on the corner of 1st Street and Park Road.
U3.q: The café is on the corner ___ 1st Street and Park Road.
U3.tip: on the corner of A and B

U3.say: Could you tell me how to get to the train station?
U3.q: Could you tell me how to get ___ the train station?
Go straight ___ 2nd Street.
U3.tip: go straight down 沿著…直走

U3.say: Turn left at the next traffic light.
U3.q: Turn left ___ the next traffic light.

U3.say: Go past the fast food restaurant, then turn right.
U3.q: Go ___ the fast food restaurant, then turn right.

U3.say: The library is next to the school.
U3.q: The library is next ___ the school.

U3.say: There's a convenience store between the bank and the hotel.
opts: There's a convenience store between the bank and the hotel.
There's a convenience store between the bank or the hotel.
There's a convenience store between of the bank and the hotel.

U3.q: Is there a parking lot nearby?
opts: Yes, there's one in front of the mall.

U3.q: Could you tell me how to get to the hospital?
opts: Sure, go straight and turn right at the corner.
